data_fields.name: respawn_rate_ticks
data_fields.donor_constant: 100 default (1 minute at 600 ms per tick); per NPC type

data_fields.name: respawn_scale_at_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: rule (4000 - players) x rate / 4000: full rate at 0 players, half at the cap

data_fields.name: death_delay_ticks
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 tick after the death animation (plus script arrive delay)

best_idea: A dead NPC keeps its slot and counts down its own respawn in server ticks; the duration is fixed at death, shrinks as the population grows (half at the cap), and the respawn returns it to its start tile and base type.
decision_why: Take the per-NPC countdown in server ticks, fixed at death, as a zone-data respawn field; reject the global server player count as the scale input (zones count their own players) and the fixed 4000/2000 constants as hard rules.
acceptance: Server test: with 0 zone players a killed NPC respawns after the base ticks; at the zone cap it respawns after half; the value is fixed at death (a player joining mid-countdown does not change it); the NPC returns to its start tile and base type.
